findings.title: Implementation plan's Global Constraint still says the round cap is spec-gate-only
findings.detail: This plan's 'Global Constraints' section states: 'Spec gate only. The plan gate keeps today's behaviour entirely — decidePlan keeps calling needsRework unchanged, and no new event is ever written for it.' The wave's own diff amends the base design (§7.3) and the fixed-point design (D5′, §8) to extend the round cap to the plan gate, and internal/decide/decide.go now does write gate_review_capped events from decidePlan (PlanRounds >= maxAgentAttempts). This plan document is not in the wave's amendment list (only the two docs/superpowers/specs/ files and the two prompt files were touched, per docs/takt/lets-work-on-69/plan.index.json), and as a completed, checkbox-driven implementation-plan artifact (all checkboxes unchecked, i.e. a historical record rather than a live reference) it may be intentionally out of scope — same convention as leaving the fixed-point design's D3/A4 text in place with an amendment rather than rewriting it. Flagging for awareness only; low confidence this needs a fix.
